fact: The Competitor appeared to fail to submit setup sheet for car 63 within the required
offence: Alleged Breach of Article 40.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative of Car 63 (George Russell). Although the FIA did not receive the setup sheet electronically in the specified time, the team was able to demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Stewards, with copies of the relevant emails, that the sheet had been emailed to the appropriate FIA department but due to some IT security issue it was not received in the specified
rules_referenced: Article 40.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 63 Alleged Failure To Submit Setup Sheet
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
